args.query: national violent crime rate murder rate FBI estimates

sql: SELECT time_series_start_year, indicator_name, estimate_domain_1, estimate_type, estimate FROM crime.bjs_nibrs_estimates WHERE time_series_start_year>=2022 AND (indicator_name ILIKE '%murder%' OR indicator_name ILIKE '%violent%') AND estimate_domain_1 ILIKE '%incident%' ORDER BY indicator_name, time_series_start_year FETCH FIRST 60 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "year", offense_code, AVG(national_offense_rate) a, COUNT(*) n FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE offense_code IN ('homicide','violent-crime') AND "year" IN (2023,2024,2025) GROUP BY "year", offense_code ORDER BY offense_code, "year"
